definition.method: Simulate isolated invocations using seeded pseudo-randomness; verify that output variances across distinct seeds remain within theoretical bounds of independent distributions, indicating no hidden persistent state leakage across provider boundaries.
definition.stop: If leakage is detected (rate > 0), immediately halt and flag for architectural review.
definition.success: Observed leakage rates are zero across all simulated invocation seeds.

proposal.summary: Proposing an experiment to empirically verify WAKE provider isolation, testing whether durable records effectively prevent state leakage across model invocations. This advances the architecture evaluation project by moving the current untested hypothesis to a valid experimental protocol.
proposal.title: WAKE Architecture and Boundary Evaluation: Testing State Isolation
